_README: Human-curated EXTERNAL SoTA entries (source=external) for the NoveltyGate's external bar. PapersWithCode's API is dead, so these are added BY HAND from real papers actually in hand. Every entry MUST have paper_title + a citation (citation/url/arxiv_id/doi) and is REFUSED otherwise. NEVER add a metric value you cannot cite to a real paper. benchmark_id must match a benchmark in the literature DB (e.g. 'benchmark:402cf4341499b795' = Continual Learning On Split CIFAR-10). For forgetting, higher_is_better=false.
